summary: beyondental has a cosmetic dentistry page and a general enquiry form. The page shows no proof and has visible errors, which cost cosmetic patients who are comparing clinics.

findings.problem: No reviews, before and after photos, accreditations or dentist names appear. Images look like stock photos of smiling people, not your clinic.
findings.cost: Cosmetic patients want to see real results and who will treat them. Stock photos tell them nothing.
findings.fix: Real clinic photos, consented before and after cases and named dentists.

findings.problem: Most booking buttons go to an external portal, the header Book an appointment goes to a different page, and the enquiry form states no response time.
findings.cost: Patients who are sent to different places or never told when you will reply book elsewhere.
findings.fix: One booking path on your own site with a stated response time.

findings.problem: A shopping cart showing $0.00 0 Cart appears twice, and the cart link goes to #. A stray x and dash show near the top.
findings.cost: An empty cart on a dental clinic page looks unfinished and raises doubts about the care.
findings.fix: Remove the cart and clean up the header.

findings.problem: Typos include eyondental's missing its first letter and Our composite bonding are designed. Several crown and whitening images use children's dentistry icon text. No from prices are shown.
findings.cost: Typos in your own name and no price guidance push patients to clinics that are clearer.
findings.fix: A proofread build with from prices for key treatments.

redesign: A proof first page with real photos, named dentists and captioned results beside every booking button.
One on site booking path with from prices.
